finding: Author provides a dense-open generic realization for abstract infinite-Weyl words and every finite bubble-point list, using a parameterized conjugated quadratic map, inverse-image open conditions and simultaneous permutation/multiplicity transport. The article positions it as an auxiliary bridge; two corollaries are stated for easier reading, one already known. Once ordinary quadratic maps and Weyl-action identities are allowed, the proof is one finite-word induction. The available material does not substantiate above-qualifying difficulty independently of article length and advanced terminology. Preserve recovered complete author text while awaiting parent admission decision.
hold_reason: Above-qualifying difficulty not established after standard quadratic-map and Weyl-action prerequisites are allowed
